comment: Semantic expectations and fixture identities for the authentic Fossil view_list same-handler acceptance and the separate selected db_prepare qualification. Values are semantic predicates and input identities only: no result counts, no source line numbers, no reviewed block constants ingested as producer truth. The candidate must recompute everything from the named inputs.

inputs.handler_sql_literal: SELECT rn, title, owner FROM reportfmt ORDER BY title

family_types.classification: useful classifications follow the actual evidence class of each fact

family_calls.direct_calls: nonempty, including the db_prepare helper call resolved to its declaration

family_database.sql_join: handler literal joins the reportfmt catalog table by identity, with catalog constraints/access facts
family_database.join_discrimination: changing helper body identity, callee identity, statement alias or SQL formatting prevents the join

family_security.guard_relations: discovered guard/deny/effect relations present; changing the actual guard changes the derived relation

db_prepare_expectations.limit: successful callee expansion in the view_list result does not replace this selected-function qualification

mutation_controls.name: guard-change
mutation_controls.rule: a copy of the source tree with the view_list guard mask changed must produce a changed derived guard relation and must not silently keep the original relation

mutation_controls.name: helper-body-change
mutation_controls.rule: a copy with the db_prepare body changed must prevent the unjustified SQL join while other families may survive

mutation_controls.name: sql-format-change
mutation_controls.rule: a copy with the handler SQL literal reformatted (same objects, different text) must refuse the join rather than match by alias spelling or formatting

provenance.read_only: the retained root is read-only; harness runs operate on verified copies under the private evidence directory
